excelImport.title: Import exam grades from Excel
excelImport.description: Upload the completed grade sheet (column A = student ID, following columns = skill/score component names matching exactly what's configured for this term, plus 2 optional columns "Overall"/"Tổng điểm" and "Level"/"Cấp độ"). The system only stores the Overall/Level values you've already calculated — it does not recompute them with any formula.
